title: Lineup For AEW Dynamite Title Tuesday Homecoming & Saturday's Collision - NewsBreak
text:
By Anthony Mango ,
1 hours ago
This Saturday’s episode of AEW Collision (airing October 4th) will be recorded tomorrow, October 2nd at the RP Funding Center in Lakeland, Florida.
Advertised for the show are two matches with Eddie Kingston against Dralistico of LFI and Kevin Knight in action against “a member of FTR” yet to be announced.
Spoilers will be available after the tapings, so stay tuned to eWrestlingNews.com for those results. Collision’s broadcast on Saturday will have a special start time of 7 p.m. ET.
READ MORE: Mini Mone Officially Returns To AEW, Orange Cassidy Reacts To His Time Off, & Lots More
READ MORE: The Justice League Goes #AllElite, AEW Stars Enter DC Universe – Details
Next week’s episode of AEW Dynamite will also air at a different time, as it will be on Tuesday night head-to-head with WWE NXT Showdown. This special will be the Homecoming “Title Tuesday” episode emanating from Daily’s Place in Jacksonville.
Mercedes Mone has said she wants to defend her TBS Championship against someone who is local from the Florida area, but her opponent has yet to be named.
Brodido will possibly put the AEW World Tag Team Championship on the line (but that was not officially confirmed) when they step in the ring with two members of The Don Callis Family who don’t get along, Kazuchika Okada and Konosuke Takeshita.
There will also be a trios No Disqualification Street Fight with The Hurt Syndicate against The Demand after a challenge issued by MVP.
To recap, here is what we know will go down on the next two AEW programs:
AEW Collision
Kevin Knight vs. TBA (“A Member of FTR”) Eddie Kingston vs. Dralistico AEW Homecoming Dynamite Title Tuesday
AEW TBS Championship Match: Mercedes Mone (c) vs. TBA (someone “local” from Florida) No Disqualification Street Fight: The Demand (Ricochet, Bishop Kaun and Toa Liona) vs. The Hurt Syndicate (Bobby Lashley, MVP, and Shelton Benjamin) *Possibly AEW World Tag Team Championship Match* Brodido (Brody King & Bandido) vs. The Don Callis Family’s Kazuchika Okada and Konosuke Takeshita Thoughts on these matches?
